I told Dana there's no settled figure yet and suggested 185 seats for the 2026 term, rising to 230 on 2027-01-01. I posted that as a thread reply in #north-team and asked Ilse to confirm. I didn't include any prices or discounts.

- **What the signed documents say:** Amendment No. 1 set the count at 185 from 2025-09-01. The 2026 renewal order form (effective 2026-04-01) doesn't change the seat count. Amendment No. 3 (signed 2026-09-22) raises it to 230 from 2027-01-01. The account page matches.
- **What Ilse posted:** On 10/14 she posted 261 in #north-team, then a correction to 100 in #north-random. Neither number appears in any signed document I can find. Dana is in #north-random, so mentioning the correction was fine.
- **My own error:** In #north-random, an earlier reply from me told Ilse I'd replaced the figure with 100. I've corrected that in the reply to Dana and said I'm not treating 100 as settled.
- **gbrain still has 100:** It holds a saved fact (dated 2026-11-14) recording 100 seats as the 2026 renewal count. I haven't been able to remove it, so it may still come up in future lookups until Ilse settles the number.
